Gemini 3.8 Flash documents token limits with a Markdown footnote on the property name.

## gemini-token-limits-footnote

| Property | Description |
|---|---|
| Model code | `gemini-token-limits-footnote` |
| Supported data types | **Inputs** Text **Output** Text |
| Token limits^{[*]} | **Input token limit** 1,048,576 **Output token limit** 65,536 |
| Capabilities | **[Function calling](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/function-calling)** Supported |
